response.justification: While the candidate demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals and senior-level experience, they lack multiple required qualifications for this role. Most critically, there is no evidence of native Japanese language proficiency (explicitly required) and minimal C programming expertise—both core requirements. The resume shows zero experience in security technologies, embedded systems, networking protocols, or firmware development. The candidate's recent 7+ years focus on web/cloud technologies (TypeScript, Node.js), not the systems-level programming and embedded security work this position demands.
strengths: Extensive 14+ years of software development experience with proven track record at multiple senior/staff-level positions
Demonstrated ability to work across diverse technical stacks and solve complex architectural problems
Strong software craftsmanship practices including TDD, CI/CD, infrastructure management, and team mentorship
concerns: No evidence of native Japanese language proficiency, which is a stated required qualification
Minimal C programming experience (only 2014-2015); seven years of recent work in TypeScript and Node.js rather than systems programming
Complete lack of demonstrated experience in security technologies, embedded systems, networking protocols, or firmware development

key_factors.factor: Insufficient C Programming and Embedded Systems Expertise
